dataIssues.detail: Official standard FarmBot Genesis v1.8 kit is sold out at supplier snapshot; v1.9 preorders and XL are different revision/configuration.
Official shop tracks are 1500mm versus v1.8 BOM 1000mm; shop main beam is 1500mm versus standard BOM 750mm segments.
Official shop GT2 belts publish 5mm width/0.75mm thickness; v1.8 BOM requires 5.8–6.0mm/1.25mm. Matching length does not qualify these belts.
Supplier v1.6+ UTM/vacuum-pump cable variants list standard 3.6m and XL5.1m; v1.8 BOM requires 2.6m and4.1m respectively.
v1.8 BOM internal-name field says Farmduino v1.6; current official shop product says v1.7+. A replacement board has not been qualified.
